description: Persistent storage configuration for stateful containers.

allowUnencryptedExisting.description:
When adding encryption, keep an installed volume with no customer-managed key
unchanged. New volumes use encryption_key; existing keys cannot be changed.

backups.description: Scheduled snapshots of each replica's volume. On by default.

enabled.description: Whether snapshots are taken. Defaults to true.

intervalHours.description: Hours between snapshots: 1, 2, 4, 6, 8, 12 or 24. Defaults to 24.

retentionDays.description: Days each snapshot is kept, at most 365. Defaults to 7.

oneOf.description: Key used to encrypt this volume and its snapshots. Cannot be changed after creation.

type.description: Resource type identifier that determines the specific kind of resource. This field is used for polymorphic deserialization and resource-specific behavior.
